notes: Training Center photographs and footage from the growth partner page, re-encoded for the web. ALT TEXT IS ROLE ONLY, never a person. The page offers 37 images and 12 videos; 19 and 8 ship. Excluded by opening each file: 17 private knowledge base screenshots carrying a personal name, a portrait and patient case data; a speaker lineup graphic and a certificate handover reel, both carrying names; a promotional card, which is an ad render rather than footage; a reel of live procedures on patients; and one image too small to use. STRIP DECLARATION: this manifest feeds the training beat's mixed marquee alongside training-media.json, so it declares `stripUnsafe`. It is computed by build_growth.py from the measured long side, not hand written, because this file is rewritten by build_growth.py, build_hd.py and vps_encode.py and a hand edit would vanish on the next run. Empty IS the declaration: the 19 photographs are 1200px or longer and the 8 clips are 720 rising to 1920.

excluded.kb-01..kb-16, digi-01: private knowledge base screenshots carrying a personal name, a portrait and patient case data
excluded.reel-01: speaker lineup graphic with names and headshots
excluded.reel-04: certificate handovers; certificates carry recipients' names
excluded.reel-03: close ups of live procedures on patients
excluded.mini-18: 320 by 240, too small for the page
